snippet.title: Jo & Rubi: A Cozy Expedition | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Jo & Rubi: A Cozy Expedition on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4941570/Jo__Rubi_A_Cozy_Expedition/

Join Jo and Rubi on a cozy archaeology expedition. Sort artefacts, clean up the garden, pull trash from the ocean, and explore a dig site. 19 relaxing mini-games across 3 chapters.

⭐ 19 mini-games across 3 chapters
✏️ A short story you can finish in one sitting
⏰ Handdrawn & Handcrafted Levels
